title: Composed supervisory control: Paused three-stage sequence with abort and per-stage timeout -> Fill-mix-drain sequence

outputs.name: A_Fault
outputs.description: Subsystem A: Abort or timeout lockout

outputs.name: A_State
outputs.description: Subsystem A: 0 idle, 1 stage1, 2 stage2, 3 stage3

outputs.name: B_State
outputs.description: Subsystem B: 0 idle, 1 fill, 2 mix, 3 drain

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: Subsystem A: The runtime scan period is 100 ms.
Subsystem A: Pausing resets rather than accumulates the stage timeout.
Subsystem A: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem B: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem B: Inputs are sampled at scan B_Start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem B: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Start in idle shall enter stage 1; each matching Done input advances exactly one stage, and A_Stage3Done returns idle with a one-scan A_Complete pulse.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Pause shall retain A_State while forcing every actuator FALSE; Done inputs while A_Paused shall not advance.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: The active stage shall time out after 500 ms of unpaused execution and latch A_Fault.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Abort shall immediately return idle, force safe outputs, and latch A_Fault.
requirements.property: G(A_Abort -> (A_State=0 AND A_Fault AND !A_Actuator1 AND !A_Actuator2 AND !A_Actuator3))

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Reset clears A_Fault only in idle while A_Start, A_Abort, and every Done input are FALSE.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: At most one actuator may be TRUE, and A_Complete shall never coincide with an actuator.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Start in idle shall enter fill and open only B_FillValve.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_State=0 AND B_Start AND !B_Abort) -> X(B_State=1)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_HighLevel shall transition fill to mix; B_MixDone transitions mix to drain.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_State=1 AND B_HighLevel)->X(B_State=2))) AND G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_State=2 AND B_MixDone)->X(B_State=3)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_LowLevel in drain shall return to idle and pulse B_Complete for one scan.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_State=3 AND B_LowLevel AND !B_Abort) -> X(B_State=0)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_FillValve, B_Mixer, and B_DrainValve shall be mutually exclusive and correspond to B_State.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Abort shall immediately return to idle, close all actuators, and suppress B_Complete.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (B_Abort -> (B_State=0 AND !B_FillValve AND !B_Mixer AND !B_DrainValve AND !B_Complete)))

requirements.text: A TRUE A_Actuator1 shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
requirements.property: G(CrossReset -> (!CrossReady AND NOT B_FillValve AND NOT B_Mixer AND NOT B_DrainValve AND NOT B_Complete AND B_State=0)) AND G((NOT (SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady)) -> (NOT B_FillValve AND NOT B_Mixer AND NOT B_DrainValve AND NOT B_Complete AND B_State=0))

requirements.text: Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
